b: Seymour Duncan has unveiled the 805+ Overdrive pedal, based on the company’s highly regarded 805 circuit but now expanded with a second voice.

In addition to delivering the classic “green” tone of the 805 with versatile EQ, the 805+ has a top-mounted two-way toggle switch to engage Plus mode, opening full-range gain and sustain while preserving your amp’s natural character.

With its easy tone shaping and clean boost capability, the 805+ can handle virtually any musical style. The 805+ Overdrive delivers everything from a subtle boost to fat crunch to searing solo tone, giving you two distinct overdrive voices in one pedal with the flip of a switch. Flip it down for Original 805 mode, Seymour Duncan’s classic screamer-esque mid-forward overdrive with a three-band active EQ. Flip up the switch for Plus mode, a full-frequency, highly adjustable overdrive—drawn from the voicing of Seymour Duncan’s Forza pedal—that delivers more gain and sustain without sacrificing the natural voice of your amp. Two personalities. One pedal.
It features true bypass switching, runs on a 9V battery or a 9V to 18V power supply, and comes wrapped in an eye-grabbing vintage-inspired housing.
Two distinct overdrive voices—classic Original 805 tones and an added full-frequency, higher-gain Plus mode
Active three-band EQ in both modes lets you dial in everything from smooth blues to tight modern metal
Wide gain range covers clean boosting, subtle breakup, saturated rhythm sounds, and sustained leads
Works with clean and overdriven amps, making it equally useful as a standalone drive, tone shaper, or front-end boost
Pedalboard-friendly top-mounted jacks, True Bypass switching
Can be powered with 9V battery or 9V to 18V external DC power
Seymour Duncan’s 805+ Overdrive is available for a street price of $189 USD. For more information, visit seymourduncan.com.
